'''Worhven''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in command of the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Dominator (Imperial-class)|''Dominator'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
Some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he led the first tests of the [[NOVA]] project. [[Probe droid/Legends|Probe droids]] were equipped with this new [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] developed by [[Santhe/Sienar Technologies]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]]. The technology was so effective that the ''Dominator'' completely lost control with its probe droids.

He later transported two [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] agents in disguise as members of the Imperial court to the planet [[Wukkar/Legends|Wukkar]].
